name: Sexual and asexual reproduction and meiosis

terms.definition: The joining (fusion) of male and female gametes, producing offspring that vary because genetic information from two parents is mixed.
terms.examiner: Gametes are sperm and egg in animals; pollen and egg cells in flowering plants.

terms.definition: One parent and no fusion of gametes; offspring are genetically identical clones; only mitosis is involved.
terms.examiner: Separate Biology: malaria parasites, fungi and strawberry runners can reproduce both ways.

terms.definition: A sex cell with half the normal number of chromosomes.
Cell division that halves the number of chromosomes to make four genetically different gametes.
terms.examiner: Two divisions; happens in the reproductive organs.

terms.definition: The fusion of two gametes, restoring the full number of chromosomes.
terms.examiner: The new cell divides by mitosis to form an embryo.

terms.definition: It produces variation, so if the environment changes some offspring may survive (natural selection); and variation can be used in selective breeding.
terms.examiner: Separate Biology compares the advantages of each type.
